data.title: Federal Reserve: AI Investment Cycle Could Soon Surpass 1990s Telecom Cycle
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, a Federal Reserve report says investment in artificial intelligence computing is accelerating and the current investment cycle could soon exceed the scale of the 1990s telecommunications cycle.

data.title: Brookfield Group Reaches Second Round of Uniper Sale
data.description: A consortium of Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board is among the bidders advancing to the second round of the sale process for Germany’s Uniper SE, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

data.title: Nvidia Says CEO Candidate Talk Is Premature as It Selects Search Firm
data.description: Nvidia said speculation that it is engaging with potential CEO candidates is premature and that it is still selecting a firm to find a successor to ousted leader Jensen Huang, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: After Mukesh Ambani, Sunil Mittal Sets Local-Control Condition for Elon Musk’s Starlink
data.description:
Bharti Airtel Chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal said Starlink can enter India only if its network’s “kill switch” and control remain in the country. Mittal told NDTV on November 13 that Elon Musk seemed impatient and frustrated, according to BeInCrypto. Mittal’s group backs OneWeb, a Starlink rival also awaiting approval, and he said Starlink’s sale in India would be “all right” with local control.

The issue drew attention after SpaceX’s Starshield, its military version of Starlink, was slowed in Ukraine from Oct. 14 to 24, United24 reported. Musk said the decision was made by U.S. President Donald Trump; Starshield is owned and controlled by the U.S. government, while Starlink is a commercial SpaceX service. Mittal said Starlink’s laser links let data bypass Indian ground stations, unlike OneWeb’s system; Tech Insider reported that the design conflicts with India’s security rules.

Jio Platforms, owned by Mukesh Ambani, listed Oct. 28 at ₹1,119 ($11.68) in India’s largest IPO and traded near ₹1,400 on Nov. 13. Jio holds 42.6% of fixed broadband lines and 77.5% of 5G home wireless, markets where Starlink could compete once approved. Musk accused Ambani of blocking Starlink; India denied bias and said Starlink filed security papers last. Mittal said in October he would welcome approval days before Musk’s and questioned demand, noting Indians can get 5G for about $3 a month—around one-tenth of satellite service’s price. India’s Cabinet must still set spectrum fees, and the Home Ministry must clear each operator before sales can begin.

data.title: Marsh’s Christine Mahoney Says Social Security Will Persist in a Different Form
data.description: Christine Mahoney, Marsh’s global defined benefit and defined contribution leader, believes Social Security will continue to exist but look different than it does today, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Solana Confidential Compute进入测试阶段
data.description: 据Odaily星球日报报道，Solana在X平台发文表示，Solana Confidential Compute现已进入测试阶段。

data.title: AI | Aaron Brown Says People Underestimate Nvidia's Impact on Daily Life
data.description:
Aaron Brown, founder and CEO of Lumbra and a former CIA officer, said people have little sense of how much Nvidia affects their daily lives, calling it a messaging challenge for the AI industry, Bloomberg reported.

Brown also said it is difficult to know exactly how the woman accused of spying on Jensen Huang became involved. He said China is skilled at identifying potential resources with business connections.

data.title: AI | Nvidia Chief Huang's Departure Puts Silicon Valley's AI Boom Outlook in Question
data.description: Nvidia chief Huang's ouster raises questions about a key part of the financial engine supporting AI, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Fed to Buy $14 Billion in Short-Term Treasuries for MBS Reinvestment
data.description: According to Jin10, the Federal Reserve will purchase $14 billion in short-term Treasury securities for MBS reinvestment.

data.title: Microsoft (MSFT.O) Says Full Restoration Timing Remains Unclear
data.description: According to Jin10, Microsoft said it is currently unable to determine when full restoration will be completed.

data.title: JPMorgan Sees AI Spending Driving Record US High-Grade Bond Supply in 2027
data.description: Bloomberg reported that JPMorgan Chase & Co. expects spending by major technology companies on artificial intelligence infrastructure, along with elevated refinancing needs, to help drive another record year of US investment-grade bond issuance.

data.title: LangChain Raises $300 Million in Series C at $3 Billion Valuation
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, LangChain completed a $300 million Series C funding round at a $3 billion valuation. The company said its agent development and management software, LangSmith, has 7,000 customers.

data.title: Meta Platforms Tests New Prediction Market App With Employees
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing The Wall Street Journal, Meta Platforms is testing a new prediction market app with employees.

data.title: US Earns C+ Grade in Global Retirement Plan Index
data.description:
The 2026 Marsh CFA Institute Global Pension Index gave the US a C+, according to Bloomberg. The index grades the best and worst retirement plans around the world.

Christine Mahoney, Marsh’s global defined benefit and defined contribution leader, discussed the index with Tom Keene on Bloomberg Money.

data.title: Bessent Blames Commerce for Nvidia Crisis as Lutnick Faces Criticism
data.description:
Bessent blamed Commerce for the Nvidia crisis, while Lutnick faced criticism, according to Bloomberg.

Denver Riggleman, CEO of RIIG Technology and a former Virginia representative, called it “mind-boggling” that anyone would defend Jensen Huang’s actions as he faces personal, political and legal fallout over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Riggleman said lawmakers seeking answers from Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick should consult intelligence experts to guide their questioning.

data.title: Kevin Hassett Denies Report He Is Leaving White House
data.description: According to CNBC, National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett said in a text message Friday that a report he was expected to leave the White House in the coming weeks was “not true.” Semafor had reported that Hassett had inquired about roles outside the administration and that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and counselor David Zervos were being considered as possible replacements, citing unnamed people familiar with Hassett’s plans. A White House official later Friday said, “There is no factual basis for this reporting,” and called Hassett a key member of President Trump’s economic team.

data.title: Ed Morse Says Current Conditions Are Inflationary
data.description: Ed Morse, senior advisor and commodities strategist at Hartree Partners, said the current environment is inflationary. He joined Tome Keene on “Bloomberg Money” to discuss the oil market, his career and China, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Bill Ackman Reacts to Jensen Huang's Nvidia Exit, Praises Anthropic IPO Roadshow Presentation
data.description: Pershing Square founder and CEO Bill Ackman said it was sad to see Jensen Huang leave Nvidia and that Huang would go on to do something great, according to Bloomberg. Ackman also said he was impressed by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's presentation at the company's IPO roadshow event in New York.

data.title: Bitcoin’s Billion-Dollar Wipeouts Are Becoming More Familiar
data.description: Bitcoin traders are accustomed to sharp market swings that can decimate portfolios within minutes. According to Bloomberg, the wipeouts are becoming bigger and more frequent, even by crypto standards.

data.title: STOCKS | Barclays Desk Turns Tactically Bullish on US Equities for First Time Since Mid-March
data.description: Barclays’ trading desk has turned tactically bullish on US equities for the first time since mid-March, as a sharp pullback in investor positioning and easing volatility pressures created an attractive opportunity for a tactical rebound, according to Bloomberg.
